en.question: How do I create a oneD account?

content.text: In the oneD app, new users must
subscribe to PREMIUM and complete payment first
. Then you can create your account (you can't create one in advance).
Choose one of 5 ways to create your account: email, phone number, Facebook, Google or Apple
enter the OTP code we send you
add an email or phone number to your profile, then confirm the OTP code
Once confirmed, you go to the home screen and can start watching

You can redeem up to 10 codes per week.

en.question: I can't log in

content.text: Check the email or phone number you get the code on. If the code hasn't arrived, request a new OTP code
If you use Facebook, Google or Apple, check your internet connection and that the account still works and isn't suspended
If you've already added an email or phone number to your profile, log in with it and confirm the OTP code
Update the app to the latest version and reopen it (on the website, refresh the page)

en.question: Can I cancel top-up days?

content.text: There's nothing to cancel: top-up days are never charged automatically. When they run out, you go back to watching with ads. (You can't cancel before they expire.)

en.question: Can I use oneD outside Thailand?

content.text: oneD works in Thailand and in some other countries, depending on licensing. What you can watch may differ by country. Live TV is only available in Thailand.
